decomposition.hypothesis: Regression dominates typical field errors; difficult tails can additionally contain representation and reference sensitivity.
decomposition.identity: Total error = regression-in-field-space + oracle representation error; report the MSE cross term, not a false additive variance attribution.
decomposition.reference_limit: Finer-reference drift is observed sensitivity, not an exact error bar or converged truth.

delivery: Reproducible matched source/raw data/models/predictions/protocols/figures; claim-by-claim outcomes including failures; no upload without user authorization.

engineering.acceptance: Positive benefit only with fewer HF calls and zero observed false acceptances; quantify finite-sample uncertainty; ambiguous/unverified identities cannot count as successes.
engineering.claim_limit: Decisions verified against the declared COMSOL reference; no universal physical safety guarantee.
engineering.task: Screen a predeclared first-mode frequency threshold; confident accept/reject or HF referral.
engineering.threshold: Median first-mode HF frequency among original train geometries, fixed before prospective labels; a benchmark threshold, not an external service safety requirement.

isolation.historical_calibration_test: Diagnostics and historical benchmarks only; not untouched evidence or model-selection labels.
isolation.model_selection: Original 48 train geometries only; geometry-grouped CV; every scaler/decoder fitted within its training fold.
isolation.prospective: Freeze fitted models/configuration/metrics before new evaluation geometries and HF labels; independent calibration; no final-label tuning.

learning_curves.policy: Same nested geometry subsets and historical evaluation cases for all families; fit representation on each subset; report tuning and runtime, and do not select models from historical-test curves.

physical_scope: Five variables; fixed Al/CCCC; original FSDT order15 and COMSOL shell builder; no aerodynamic or damage extension.

prospective.distribution: Independent uniform draws within the five original physical bounds; IID calibration/test use the same distribution.
prospective.geometry_generation: Only after model freeze; deterministic independent RNG streams, new run IDs above10000, no duplicate old designs.
prospective.region: theta_c>=60 degrees; separate exclusion model fitted/tuned only below60; calibrate its in-region-of-training scale below60 and report challenge coverage as shift diagnostics, not a guarantee.

reference.acceptance: Retain individual modes regardless of outcome. Accept subspace interpretation only with stable quadrature and observed span stability; never call a sampled-field span full-DOF convergence.
reference.additional_solve_policy: Choose a specific numerical experiment only after diagnosis; no unchanged automatic retry or blind largest-mesh escalation.
diagnostics: Common-shell mass-weighted full displacement/director span if native variables are available
reference.hypothesis: Close-mode numerical basis mixing explains individual-shape drift better than a change in the modal subspace.
reference.neighbor_selection: Nearest campaign-reference frequency; fixed before projecting any finer fields.

resources.policy: Durable stage/native progress; retain failures; all owned worker trees stopped on parent loss or deadline.

selection.candidate_policy: Small, finite targeted GP/representation changes chosen from training-only decomposition; no automatic nonlinear-decoder upgrade.
selection.neural_scope: Required by proposal: genuine coordinate-conditioned MLP with design, mode and LF conditioning, structural boundary factor; Fourier ridge remains labeled as a proxy.
selection.promotion: At least5% primary improvement over original PCA48/RBF with no more than5% degradation in frequency median or field P95 on identical train-only folds; retain negative results.

uncertainty.caution: Finite conformal ranks do not establish sharpness, stable estimated coverage or conditional/shift coverage.
uncertainty.hypothesis: Training-only error-informed uncertainty can provide sharper useful referral decisions than raw GP scales.
uncertainty.selection: Train-only validation; any residual-based scale fitted without the validation geometry; final calibration changes widths only.
